_why: Guest Contact's rules as cases, one table for two readers (CLAUDE.md rules 1 and 3). waWindow, contactChannel and contactTemplateText live in nala-shared.js for the page and again in worker/guest-contact.js, because a Worker cannot import from the site: the page previews what the Worker sends and says when the 24 hours close, and the Worker refuses free text outside them. contact_suite.py runs the page's copies through this table and worker/contact-test.mjs the Worker's; a case added here fails whichever copy has not learned it. contactRowState is the page's alone, pinned here all the same because it is the colour a row wears.

window._note: [guest's last WhatsApp message, now, open?, closes at]. Meta's rule: free text only within 24 hours of the guest's last WhatsApp message. Stamps are compared as instants, whatever zone they were written in.

channel._note: [thread, now, which way a message from us goes]. none: texted STOP. wa: WhatsApp free text. watpl: WhatsApp, approved wording only. sms: SMS free text. A guest who wrote in the last 24 hours is answered the way they wrote; otherwise WhatsApp only for a guest who agreed (the desk's switch, or they once wrote there) and whose number WhatsApp knows.

row._note: [thread, unsorted messages, open tasks, has a sendable mobile, the row's state]. fresh is white (work to do), task amber, sent the waiting grey, done green, none and nophone sunk.

templates._note: [template, first name, arrival day, the words]. The approved WhatsApp wording, as the preview shows it and the Worker records it. GUEST-CONTACT.md holds the same text with {{1}} and {{2}} for Meta.
